login.title: Sign in
login.intro: {{brand}} internal panel. Sign in with the email and password you were given.

change.title: Change your password
change.intro: You're using a temporary password. Choose your own before you see the panel. This isn't an error: it only happens once.
change.hint: At least {{min}} characters. A phrase you remember works.
change.done: Password saved. Your other open sessions were closed.
change.mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.

guide.title: Panel guide
guide.lead: This is where {{brand}}'s internal documents live: the plans, the dated decisions, the status of each part and the rules we work by.
guide.what1: “Work rules”: how we work on any project (language, how we decide, how we test, how we publish).
guide.what2: “General plan”: the whole app. PLAN is the idea and the phases; STATUS is what was done each day; the chat kickoff sums up where we left off.
guide.what3: “Landing”: the website, with its plan, status and design plan.
guide.how1: Pick a document in the index on the left (on a phone, with the “Index” button).
guide.how2: Use search to find a word in every document; case and accents don't matter.
guide.how3: Documents are read straight from the project plans: when something is written down, it shows up here on its own.
guide.note1: Internal documents are in Spanish, even when the panel is in English.
guide.note2: Images and HTML previews from the plans aren't shown here. The design directions are at {{url}}.
guide.note3: Your session lasts 12 hours. If someone changes your password, the session ends on its own.
guide.roleViewer: Read only: sees the documents marked for everyone.
guide.roleAdmin: Admin: also sees the administration documents.
guide.roleSuper: Superadmin: sees everything and manages panel users.

doc.notFound: That document doesn't exist or was moved. Pick another one in the index.
doc.empty: There are no documents you can see yet.

search.title: Results for “{{q}}”
search.none: No results for “{{q}}”. Try another word.

users.title: Panel users
users.intro: New passwords are temporary: they're shown once and the person must change it when signing in.
users.confirmRemove: Remove {{email}} from the panel? They lose access right away.
users.confirmReset: Give {{email}} a new temporary password? Their current session ends.
users.tempText: Copy it and send it over a private channel. It won't be shown again.

errors.unauthorized: The email or password doesn't match.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.password_too_short: The new password is too short.
errors.password_same: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.email_taken: There's already a user with that email.
errors.invalid_query: Search must be between 2 and 100 characters.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something failed on the server. Try again in a moment.
